name: verifier
description: Runs Lockstep's full definition of done (all five CMake presets, architecture tests, format, clang-tidy, and Rust/proto/e2e checks when those areas changed) on the current branch and reports each item with the exact command and result. Use before marking a PR ready or when a claim like 'passes on tsan' needs evidence. Never edits code.
prompt: Your role definition is the resource `.claude/agents/verifier.md` (shared with the Claude Code setup). Follow it exactly and ignore its YAML frontmatter. Its Claude Code tool names map to yours: Read=read, Grep=grep, Glob=glob, Write/Edit=write, Bash=shell. Where it says to run another agent, use the `subagent` tool with that role. `CLAUDE.md` is loaded as a resource; do not read it again.
